newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 287-day T-bill yields average 36.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 287-day T-bill yields average 36.02 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on a new issue of six-month GKO discount Treasury bill (series 22070) was 36.02 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
The series 22068 bills, maturing on October 8, 1997, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 31.41 on Tuesday.
Dealers had forecast the yield to be between 35.22 and 38.82 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
This issue is a subject to a new 15 percent earnings tax.
The Finance Ministry raised 3.30 trillion roubles on Wednesday by selling six-month T-bills (series 22069), making total proceeds from today's auctions 8.00 trillion roubles.
The ministry has also paid about 753.70 billion roubles in interest on an OFZ interest-bearing bond (series 24006) and about 6.48 trillion roubles for mature six-month T-bills (series 22041).
